candidate_gaia_association.association_method: reciprocal-nearest detector-candidate to epoch-propagated Gaia, using the already-frozen v068a reciprocal matching implementation
candidate_gaia_association.candidate_coordinates: frozen v056 detector RA/Dec recovered exactly by endpoint_key + tile_id + candidate_index

gaia_static_triage.data_source: already-acquired offline v064/v066 Gaia transport caches only

proper_motion.finite_pmra_pmdec_and_ref_epoch: propagate with the frozen v068a apply_space_motion implementation
proper_motion.missing_pm: retain as explicit PM_INCOMPLETE catalogue context only; do not interpret non-association as catalogue absence
proper_motion.parallax: record if available but do not fold into the ordinary-source positional gate; parallax-aware search remains separate

interpretation.unexplained_primary_survivors_proceed_to: deterministic morphology context then sensitivity-qualified recurrence/injection-recovery under separately frozen downstream stages

population.diagnostic_population_definition: registration_mode == PRIMARY AND corrected_le3 == True AND loo_corrected_sep_max_arcsec > 3.0
population.primary_population_definition: registration_mode == PRIMARY AND corrected_le3 == True AND loo_corrected_sep_max_arcsec <= 3.0

purpose: Prospectively freeze the first candidate-level mechanical triage for wide-census pair 17 before any pair-17 Gaia candidate-association outcomes are inspected.

triage_classes.DIFFERENT_GAIA_SOURCES: Both endpoints have <=5 arcsec Gaia associations but to different source_id values.
triage_classes.GAIA_ASSOCIATION_AMBIGUOUS_OR_PM_INCOMPL: Catalogue coverage or proper-motion information is insufficient for a clean endpoint classification.
triage_classes.NO_GAIA_WITHIN_5_ARCSEC: Neither endpoint has a usable <=5 arcsec epoch-aware Gaia association.
triage_classes.ONE_ENDPOINT_GAIA_ONLY: Only one endpoint has a <=5 arcsec Gaia association, or the other endpoint association is PM-incomplete/ambiguous.
triage_classes.SAME_GAIA_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: Both endpoints associate to the same Gaia source_id but one or both endpoint separations are >3 and <=5 arcsec.
triage_classes.SAME_GAIA_STRICT_BOTH_ENDPOINTS: Both endpoint detections reciprocally associate within <=3 arcsec to the same epoch-propagated Gaia source_id.
